title: Pan-Fried Jiaozi with Pickle Slaw
description: A Chinese-inspired recipe that combines the flavors of pan-fried jiaozi with a refreshing pickle slaw.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the jiaozi to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
While the jiaozi is cooking, prepare the pickle slaw by mixing together the sliced pickles, rice vinegar, and grated ginger in a bowl.
Once the jiaozi is cooked, remove it from the skillet and add the chopped green onions to the skillet.
Cook for 1 minute, until the green onions are wilted.
Serve the jiaozi with the pickle slaw on top.
Garnish with additional chopped green onions, if desired.
